site.name: fairrentcalc.com
site.description: Open-source, developer-grade digital calculations for room dividing, screen scaling, and fair rental valuation.
hero.badge: Physical Blueprint Calibration is now live. Try it →
hero.title: Rent sharing, mathematically resolved.
hero.subtitle: No more arguments over who has the private bathroom or a bigger room. Calibrate your device's screen to measure floor plans, adjust feature weights, and split rent fairly.
features.title: Rent Splitter
features.split.desc: Input room sizes and features. Adjust slider weights for private bathrooms, balconies, or closets. Let the algorithm split rent mathematically.
features.calibrator.title: Physical Calibrator
features.calibrator.desc: Use a credit card against your screen to auto-detect your display's PPI and true diagonal. Measures physical blueprint layouts in real-time.
features.evaluator.title: Listing Evaluator
features.evaluator.desc: Compare listing rent prices against income bounds and local square footage indices. Check if an apartment is a steal or overpriced.
comparison.label: Engineering Focus
comparison.title: Why standard calculators fail roommate groups.
comparison.p1: Legacy tools force arbitrary fixed pricing formulas. They assume a private bathroom is worth exactly the same amount in a cheap flat as in a high-end luxury townhouse.
comparison.p2: With fairrentcalc.com, your group dictates the values. Adjust the visual sliders to negotiate the weights. Measure your floor plan to scale directly on screen.
cta.title: Ready to make renting fair?
cta.subtitle: Choose a tool below to run your calculations immediately. No login required.
split.title: Divide rent amongst roommates.
split.subtitle: Adjust weights for room features, add rooms, and adjust dimensions. Calculations update in real-time.
split.rent.label: Total Monthly Rent
split.rent.info: Adjust the total monthly rent, then tweak amenity weight percentages below to allocate premiums.
split.room.name.label: Room name
split.calibrate.desc: Unsure about the exact dimensions? Calibrate your screen using a credit card to measure your layout blueprints.
split.table.title: Detailed Mathematical Split Table
split.empty: No rooms added. Click "+ Add Room" above to begin.
calibrate.title: Device & Blueprint Calibrator.
calibrate.subtitle: Calibrate your screen's physical PPI using a standard credit card. This lets you auto-detect display sizes and measure layout blueprints to scale.
calibrate.card.title: 1. Credit Card Calibration
calibrate.card.desc: Lay any physical credit card, debit card, or ID card flat against your screen. Adjust the slider until the outline below matches the physical card's edges exactly.
calibrate.blueprint.title: 2. Interactive Blueprint & Blueprint Scale Tool
calibrate.blueprint.desc: Place your blueprint or room drawing over the screen (or use this screen scale to calculate distances). Set your blueprint ratio below:
calibrate.ruler: Ruler Scale Pad (Tap any 2 spots to measure distance)
calibrate.ruler.instruction: Click/Tap in two separate positions on this canvas to trace a line and calculate its physical and real-world distance.
evaluate.title: Listing & Affordability Evaluator.
evaluate.subtitle: Check if a listing's rent matches its true physical market value, and verify if it aligns with your group's income thresholds.
evaluate.income.label: Combined Gross Monthly Income
evaluate.income.desc: Total combined income of all roommates before taxes.
evaluate.budget.title: 50/30/20 Monthly Allocation Breakdown
evaluate.diagnostic.affordable.desc: This apartment fits comfortably within your group's 30% monthly gross income threshold.
evaluate.diagnostic.stretched.desc: Rent is stretching your budget, occupying between 30% and 40% of gross monthly income.
evaluate.diagnostic.highBurden.desc: Rent exceeds 40% of gross monthly income. Significant risk of rent burden for roommate group.
evaluate.comparison.title: Listing Cost vs. Estimated Market Fair Value
evaluate.comparison.desc: We evaluate the listed monthly price against the physical attributes of the apartment. Our model computes the base rent by multiplying square footage by location-tier coefficient, then adds custom market-average surcharges for utility/amenity packages.
evaluate.meter.title: Market Comparison Meter
